description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1 , me ballkon ne Shkoze. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 5 te nje pallati te ri , te mireadministruar me ashensor. Ndodhet ne katin e 5 , ka nje siperfaqe totale 89 m2 , dhe siperfaqe neto 82 m2.
Apartamenti eshte i mobiluar , dhe i investuar.
Dsiponon certifikate pronesie.
Dalje direkte ne unaze te madhe.
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, with a balcony in Shkoza. The apartment is located on the 5th floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator. It is located on the 5th floor, has a total area of ​​89 m2, and a net area of ​​82 m2. The apartment is furnished and invested. It provides ownership certificates. Direct exit to the big ring.
